content.hebrew: אָפֵס אָרוֹן / וְגָבַר חָרוֹן / וְאֵין מִזֶּֽרַע אַהֲרֹן / לְהִתְמַנּוֹת כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Afas aron / veḡavar ḥaron / ve’en mizzera‘ aharon / lehitmannot kohen.
content.english: The Ark is no more, and rage dominates. There is none from Aaron’s seed to be appointed as priest.

content.hebrew: בְּזָנְחֵֽנוּ מִצְוֹת / מִלַּֽהַב חֲצוּבוֹת / וְאֵין מִי לְצַוּוֹת / כְּצִוּוּי כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Bezonḥenu mitsvot / millahav ḥatsuvot / ve’en mi letsavvot / ketsivvui kohen.
content.english: Since we have abandoned the commandments that were hewn out from flame, there is none to give instruction like the instructions of a priest.

content.hebrew: גָּבְרוּ עֲוֹנוֹת / וְשָׁמְמוּ מְעוֹנוֹת / וּבָטְלוּ קָרְבָּנוֹת / מֵהַגִּישׁ כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Gaveru ‘avonot / veshamemu me‘onot / uvatelu ḳorbanot / mehaggish kohen.
content.english: Sins dominate, and [God’s] dwelling places [of the Temple] are desolate, and the sacrifices are gone, which the priest would bring near [to God].

content.hebrew: דָּמְמוּ כְלֵי שִׁיר / מִשַּֽׁעַר הַשִּׁיר / וְאֵין מְנַגֵּן בְּשִׁיר / כְּנִגּוּן כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Damemu chelé shir / mish-sha‘ar hash-shir / ve’en menaggen beshir / keniggun kohen.
content.english: The musical instruments are silent from the Gate of Song; and there is none to make music, in songs, like the music of the priest.

content.hebrew: הֵרַֽעְנוּ יֵֽצֶר / וְהִכְעַֽסְנוּ יוֹצֵר / וְאֵין מֵסִיר וְעוֹצֵר / אַף וָנֶֽגֶף כַּכֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Hera‘nu yetser / vehich‘asnu yotser / ve’en mesir ve‘otser / af vaneḡef kakkohen.
content.english: We have made our inclination evil, and enraged our Creator; and there is none to remove, to stop, rage and anger, like the priest.

content.hebrew: וְגָדְלָה אֲנָחָה / וְשָׁבְתָה הֲנָחָה / וְאֵין עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה / לְהַקְרִיב כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Veḡadela anaḥa / veshaveta hanaḥa / ve’en ‘ola uminḥa / lehaḳriv kohen.
content.english: And moaning is great, and relief is over, and there is no burnt offering or meal offering, for the priest to offer.

content.hebrew: זְמִירוֹת בָּטָֽלוּ / זְמַנִּים הוּטָֽלוּ / קָרְבָּנוֹת נִטַּלְטָֽלוּ / מֵחַשֵּׁב כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Zemirot batalu / zemannim hutalu / ḳorbanot nittaltalu / meḥash-shev kohen.
content.english: Songs are no more, [festive] times have been removed, sacrifices have been taken away – from the priest to calculate [what is offered when].

content.hebrew: חָדְלוּ רָאשִׁים / זְקֵנִים וִישִׁישִׁים / וְאֵין זִבְחֵי אִשִּׁים / לִזְבֹּֽחַ כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Ḥadelu rashim / zeḳenim vishishim / ve’en zivḥé ish-shim / lizboaḥ kohen.
content.english: Gone are the heads, the elders and presbyters; and there are no fire-offerings for the priest to offer.

content.hebrew: טִירַת מְשׂוֹשֵֽׂנוּ / הָרְסוּ שׁוֹסֵֽינוּ / וְרַבּוּ חוֹמְסֵֽינוּ / וְאֵין לָֽנוּ מְכַהֵן.
content.transliteration: Tirat mesosenu / haresu shosenu / verabbu ḥomesenu / ve’en lanu mechahen.
content.english: Our joyous fortress [the Temple] – those that plundered us have torn it down; and those that do us violence have proliferated, and we have none to serve as priest.

content.hebrew: יָדֵֽינוּ קָפַֽצְנוּ / צְדָקָה לֹא חָפַֽצְנוּ / טוֹב לָרַע פָּצִֽינוּ / לָכֵן דַּלּֽוֹנוּ מִכַּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Yadenu ḳafatsnu / tsedaḳa lo ḥafatsnu / tov lara‘ patsinu / lachen dallonu mikkahen.
content.english: We have kept our hands closed, and not wanted [to give] charity; we have said “good” about bad – therefore we are impoverished from [having] a priest.

content.hebrew: כִּעַֽסְנוּ בְּתוֹעֵבוֹת / לְבֹחֵן לְבָבוֹת / וְאֵין נְדָרִים וּנְדָבוֹת / לְהַגִּישׁ כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Ki‘asnu beto‘evot / levoḥen levavot / ve’en nedarim undavot / lehaggish kohen.
content.english: We have, through our abominations, caused the One that Investigates Hearts to become enraged; and there are no vowed offerings or freewill offerings, for the priest to bring near [to God].

content.hebrew: לֹא סַֽרְנוּ מִלֶּֽכֶת / בְּדֶֽרֶךְ מְלֻכְלֶֽכֶת / נִקְרַע זֵר מַמְלֶֽכֶת / מֵהַמְלִיךְ כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Lo sarnu millechet / bederech meluchlechet / niḳra‘ zer mamlechet / mehamlich kohen.
content.english: We have not ceased to walk in the filthy path; the royal crown has been torn off, so that we cannot crown a priest.

content.hebrew: מָֽטָה רַגְלֵֽנוּ / וּבָטַל גִּילֵֽנוּ / וְנִמְנְעוּ רַגְלֵֽינוּ / מֵעֲלוֹת אֶל כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Mata raḡlenu / uvatal gilenu / venimne‘u raḡlenu / me‘alot el kohen.
content.english: Our foot has faltered, and our joy is over, and our feet no longer go up to [meet] the priest.

content.hebrew: נִגְנְזוּ סְפָרִים / מִמְּקוֹם שְׁחִיטַת פָּרִים / וְאֵין פַּר יוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים / לְכַפֵּר כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Niḡnezu sefarim / mimmeḳom sheḥitat parim / ve’en par yom hakkippurim / lechapper kohen.
content.english: The books have been put away from [the Temple], the place where bullocks were slaughtered; and there is no bullock of Yom Kippur, for the priest to perform atonement.

content.hebrew: סַֽרְנוּ מֵאָרְחוֹת / אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחוֹת / וְלֹא מָצָֽאנוּ רְוָחוֹת / לְבַקֵּשׁ כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Sarnu me’orḥot / elohé haruḥot / velo matsanu revaḥot / levaḳḳesh kohen.
content.english: We have strayed from the paths of the God of Spirits; and we have found no relief to seek a priest.

content.hebrew: עָרְבָה כָּל שִׂמְחָה / וְגָדְלָה אֲנָחָה / וְאֵין מִי לְהַקְרִיב מִנְחָה / אֵֽצֶל כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: ‘Areva kol simḥa / veḡadela anaḥa / ve’en mi lehaḳriv minḥa / etsel kohen.
content.english: All joy has darkened, and moaning has become great, and there is none to offer a meal-offering at the priest’s side.

content.hebrew: פָּרַֽצְנוּ גָּדֵר / וְהִלַּֽכְנוּ קֹדֵר / וְאֵין מִצְנֶֽפֶת לְהַדֵּר / מוּל פְּנֵי כֹהֵן.
content.transliteration: Paratsnu gader / vehillachnu ḳoder / ve’en mitsnefet lehadder / mul pené chohen.
content.english: We have burst through the boundaries [of propriety], and walked in darkness, and there is no turban to beautify the face of the priest.

content.hebrew: צֹרְרֵֽינוּ נִתְרַבּוּ / וְעֹיְנֵינוּ רָבוּ / אֹיְבֵֽינוּ רַֽבּוּ / וְאָפַס כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Tsorerenu nitrabbu / ve‘oyenenu ravu / oyevenu rabbu / ve’afas kohen.
content.english: Our foes have become many, and hostile people quarrel with us, and our enemies have proliferated, and there is no priest.

content.hebrew: קוֹמָתֵֽנוּ נָפְלָה / וּבָשְׁתֵּֽנוּ גָדְלָה / וְרָבְתָה דַלָּה / וְאֵין לְגַדֵּל כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Ḳomatenu nafela / uvoshtenu ḡadela / veraveta dalla / ve’en leḡaddel kohen.
content.english: Our stature has fallen, and our shame has become great, and poverty has become prevalent, and we cannot raise a priest.

content.hebrew: רֹאשֵֽׁנוּ נָפַל / יְגוֹנֵֽנוּ נִכְפָּל / מְאוֹרֵֽנוּ אָפַל / וְאֵין לְהַדְלִיק כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Roshenu nafal / yeḡonenu nichpal / me’orenu afal / ve’en lehadliḳ kohen.
content.english: Our head has fallen, our anguish has doubled, our light has darkened, and there is no priest to kindle it.

content.hebrew: שִׁירוֹתֵֽינוּ עָרְבוּ / קִינוֹתֵֽינוּ רָבוּ / נֵרוֹתֵֽנוּ כָּבוּ / וְאֵין לְהַעֲלוֹת כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Shirotenu ‘arevu / ḳinotenu ravu / nerotenu kavu / ve’en leha‘alot kohen.
content.english: Our songs have darkened, our lamentations have become many, our lamps have been extinguished, and there is no priest to light them.

content.hebrew: תְּמִימֵֽינוּ נֶאֱסָֽפוּ / טַפֵּֽינוּ נֶחְטָֽפוּ / עֶלְבּוֹנֵֽינוּ נוֹסָֽפוּ / כִּי נִכְחַד כֹּהֵן.
content.transliteration: Temimenu ne’esafu / tappenu neḥtafu / ‘elbonenu nosafu / ki nichḥad kohen.
content.english: Our perfect ones have passed away, our babes have been snatched, our shame has increased, for the priest has been cut off.
